**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Force injecting-mode advice to inline**

When an extension mixes inline and `inline = false` advice, or explicitly selects `HelperClassStrategy.INJECTED`, `AdviceInspector.useIsolatedAdvice()` intentionally falls back to the injecting installer, but this pool now preserves the source `inline = false`. Muzzle does not include the advice class itself in the default injected-helper list, so the transformed application emits a direct call to a class its loader cannot see and the advice hits `NoClassDefFoundError` (or is silently skipped when suppressed). Retain the `AdviceInliningPoolStrategy(..., true)` override so source `inline` remains only the strategy signal in this path.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L20-L22](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/519bcb36a0f0a7cf004f8629eb0d6c95caf7eafe/AGENTS.md#L20-L22)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Force isolated-mode advice to stay non-inline**

When an extension forces `HelperClassStrategy.ISOLATED` for source-inline or mixed advice that invokes normal helpers, `InstrumentationModuleInstaller.useIndy()` deliberately selects this transformer, but this pool leaves those methods inline. Byte Buddy then copies their helper calls into application bytecode even though `installIndyModule()` keeps the helpers in the isolated instrumentation loader, so the calls cannot link and telemetry fails or no-ops instead of being dispatched through `IndyBootstrap`. Retain the `AdviceInliningPoolStrategy(..., false)` override.
